types.declaration:
/** Smooth monotone interpolation, or literal straight segments between observations. */
export type ChartCurve = "smooth" | "linear";
types.name: ChartCurve

types.declaration:
/** A fixed drawing height, or a chart that uses its bounded parent panel's remaining height. */
export type ChartHeight = number | "fill";
types.name: ChartHeight

types.declaration:
/** Chart-local chrome configuration. All lengths still inherit the surrounding Density. */
export type ChartLayout = "auto" | "dense" | "roomy";
types.name: ChartLayout

types.declaration:
/** Load as the figure nears the viewport, or immediately after mounting. */
export type ChartLoading = "lazy" | "eager";
types.name: ChartLoading

types.declaration:
/** Renders one numeric value as axis or bin text. */
export type ChartNumberFormat = (value: number) => string;
types.name: ChartNumberFormat

types.declaration:
/** Stable entity ids mapped to color tokens; sorting never reassigns these colors. */
export type ChartPalette = Readonly<Record<string, ColorToken>>;
types.name: ChartPalette

types.declaration:
/** Exact sample details can stay inline, overlay the plot during inspection, or remain available to assistive technology only. */
export type ChartReadout = "auto" | "inline" | "overlay" | "hidden";
types.name: ChartReadout
ChartSeries

types.declaration:
/** Shared Density-relative plot height; `height` remains the explicit pixel override. */
export type ChartSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg";
types.name: ChartSize

types.declaration:
/** Exact continuous sample-axis bounds shared between comparison panels. */
export type ChartTimeRange = readonly [ChartTimestamp, ChartTimestamp];
types.name: ChartTimeRange

types.declaration:
/** Continuous chart coordinate: epoch milliseconds or an equivalent Date. */
export type ChartTimestamp = number | Date;
types.name: ChartTimestamp

types.declaration:
/** A CSS custom property supplied by the DS or the host application. */
export type ColorToken = `--${string}`;
types.name: ColorToken
TimeSeriesDataset
TimeSeriesPoint

types.declaration:
/** Shared temporal mark vocabulary. */
export type TimeSeriesVariant = "line" | "area" | "stacked-area" | "bar";
types.name: TimeSeriesVariant

events.description: Called after a legend action changes hidden dataset ids.
events.name: onhiddenserieschange

events.description: Reports linked inspection as an epoch timestamp, or null to clear it.
events.name: onactivexchange

events.description: Commits a sample with a pointer press or Enter/Space, independently of hover inspection.
events.name: onselect

props.description: Exact continuous sample-axis viewport, shared between panels. Omitted, fits the supplied observations. Value scales still describe the supplied data.
props.name: timeRange

props.description: Linked inspection timestamp. Null clears the drawn cursor and reads the latest observation; omitted, inspection is local. The nearest retained observation supplies the exact reading. Bindable.
props.name: activeX

props.description: `roomy` preserves the original chrome; `dense` moves details over the plot; `auto` uses dense geometry in narrow containers. Every mode inherits Density spatial roles without selecting Theme or Density.
props.name: layout

props.description: `auto` follows layout: inline when roomy, otherwise overlaid during pointer/keyboard inspection. Explicit modes override placement independently. Hidden details remain in the explorer's accessible reading.
props.name: readout

props.description: Points as `{ x, y }`, or named datasets `{ id, label, data, series? }` sharing the same axes. Dataset ids preserve legend visibility across refreshes.
props.name: data

props.description: Accessible description of the represented values.
props.name: label

props.description: `line` reads its own range, `area` fills each series to zero, and `stacked-area` or `bar` stack named contributions around zero. Stacked areas leave a gap wherever any visible contribution is unavailable.
props.name: variant

props.description: `smooth` (default) uses monotone curves through observations; `linear` draws straight segments. Applies to lines and areas; bars are unchanged.
props.name: curve

props.description: `full` includes axes and a grid; `minimal` keeps only the plotted marks and removes their gutters.
props.name: presentation

props.description: Shared Density-relative plot height: three, six or ten control rows. An explicit `height` wins. Omitted, keeps the simple/interactive default.
props.name: size

props.description: Stable dataset ids hidden from the plot. Bindable so a summary and its expanded view can share visibility.
props.name: hiddenSeries

props.description: Renders a value-axis tick. Defaults to a locale-free number of at most two decimals.
props.name: format

props.description: Formats time-axis ticks and the shared readout; omitted, Date axes use compact UTC labels, numeric axes retain the engine's formatter, and the readout uses exact UTC timestamps.
props.name: formatX

props.description: Exact shared value-axis bounds, e.g. `[0, 100]` for percentages. Omitted, follows all datasets. Must be finite and increasing; an area domain must include zero.
props.name: valueDomain

props.description: Show legend toggles and a shared pointer/keyboard readout. Defaults to true for named datasets, false for a simple point array.
props.name: interactive

props.description: The Series Role (1–6) the series is drawn in. Never the Brand red.
props.name: series

props.description: Explicit color custom-property name; omitted, keeps the DS series role.
props.name: color

props.description: Positive line/area outline width in drawing pixels; defaults to 2.
props.name: strokeWidth

props.description: Dataset-id palette, overridden by a dataset color.
props.name: palette

props.description: Fixed drawing width in px. Omitted, the series fills its figure's content width and follows it on resize (640 until the figure is measured); the container sets that width, and the chart never widens its container.
props.name: width

props.description: Drawing height in pixels, or `fill` to consume a bounded parent panel. Omitted, inherits Density-relative sizing; dense/auto narrow layouts use six rows.
props.name: height

props.description: When LayerChart loads: `lazy` (default) once the figure nears the viewport, `eager` as soon as it mounts. Until then — and in the server render — the figure holds a placeholder of the chart's own Density-sized height under its accessible name.
props.name: loading

props.description: Called after a legend action changes hidden dataset ids.
props.name: onHiddenSeriesChange

props.description: Reports linked inspection as an epoch timestamp, or null to clear it.
props.name: onActiveXChange

props.description: Commits a sample with a pointer press or Enter/Space, independently of hover inspection.
props.name: onSelect

props.description: Extra classes, merged onto the chart's root `figure`.
props.name: className
